system.description: As two of your actions (◈◈), three of your thralls that stand adjacent to one another fuse into a Carrion Hulk: a single thrall with 12 HP and -d2 armour, whose heavy limbs deal d6 and reach 10'. It is still a mook, but it is destroyed only at 0 HP. It is commanded like a thrall, and collapses when the encounter ends.
